profile.headline: Software Engineer at Electronic Arts (EA)
profile.summary: Experienced Game Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer games industry. Skilled in C, C++, Mobile Applications, Java, Android Development, C#, and Unity3D. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor's of Science in Computer Science from University of Nevada-Las Vegas.

positions.locationName: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Popcap Team
Software Engineer on Plants vs. Zombies

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description:
MyVegas Games Team
● Engineered social slot machine games using Unity3D, C#, and Lua.
● Lead front end developer on Disco Dracula, Rainbow Risers, Luxor Link, Yin Yang Fortunes, and Money Bolt.
● Front end engineer on Rapid Gold, Shaq 9, Munsters Lightning Lab, Watch What Happens Live, and Devin and Dell.
● Cross-discipline communication with product managers, game designers, backend engineers, technical/visual effects artists, and sound design to bring our games to life.
● Ported older slot titles to our updated game engine based on Unity3D.

positions.title: Mobile Developer
positions.description:
Primary Android Developer
● Updated Android app to be Android design compliant by implementing a navigation drawer menu system.
● Implemented drag based funding system using Android's built in drag and drop and animation functionality.
● Expanded in app invite functionality to allow the use of Facebook, Twitter, and other social media sites.
● Lead architect on Android Wear and Android widget versions of the WiseBanyan app.
● Implemented a receipt based recommendation system to recommend the user to different parts of the app.
● Modernized milestone creation and edit flows.
● Implemented in app billing and premium production selection.
● Implemented and added a modular in app survey and recommendation system.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Independent contractor for BlueFlare, LLC.
● Worked on the updates for AdLove. Which is a rewards app for iOS and Android. 
● Implemented custom alerts that uses Parse.com to serve the push notifications.
● Updated the account page layout, and implemented the refer a friend pop-up from scratch.
● Implemented the client side functionality for the donation pop-up. Originally a part of the app. It was moved to a web form. Pressing the donate button now generates a link and opens the browser.
● Modernized the layout for the Android version from a tabbed layout to using a navigation drawer.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Sunstorm Games/Tabtale USA (Feb 2013-Jan 2016)
● Updated, maintained, and implemented new features in 40+ native iOS and Unity games.
● Integrated new and updated ad networks, ad mediation in our native iOS and Unity games.
● Developed an analytics framework that interfaces with Upsight/Kontagent. The framework was used in all of our native iOS games.
● Updated and maintained, UnityExternals 2.0, our internal IAP, ad mediation, and analytics framework.
● Developed an ad framework that interfaces with Ad Colony, Ad Mob, Inmobi, and others. The framework was used in all of our native iOS games.
● Developed an internal "Ready, Set, Rescue" prototype.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Sunstorm Games acquired by Tabtale. I had the same responsibilities at TabTale and Sunstorm.
